# tarsus

> Tarsus (formerly *omnitool*) is the "hands" of an agent: one call carries a JSON batch of operations (`bash`, `read`, `write`, `patch`, `sql`, `glob`, `grep`, `fix_json`), which is repaired, validated, safety-checked and executed in parallel, sequentially or in dependency order, and answered with on

Setup: `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/SovRing-Labs/tarsus && cd tarsus && python3 bin/omnitool_guard.py selftest` (expect: OMNITOOL-GUARD SELFTEST: PASS (62/62)).
Licence: PolyForm Small Business 1.0.0 OR PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 (free trial for evaluation).
